command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek supplies no executable command and treats raw bytes as mandatory despite the source's standard high-level list reads. Raw access is prohibited unless an approved private-script contract demonstrates additional required coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect complete standard IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists plus five exact protected rear Web rows; correlate each rear tachometer with its upper FRU, front mate and capture context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five upper-rear resources and five interfaces remain; broad filtering, generic clear, front substitution and guessed raw commands are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use five FRU rows containing rear and paired front sensor identities, control/PWM/load context, all five rear timestamped values, optional paired-front contemporaneous values and approved relationship result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds dual-rotor pairing and operating-context semantics while retaining safe standard read paths.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A healthy front rotor can mask a stopped rear rotor in broad fan output, and swapped F/R labels can yield plausible RPMs without proving rear cooling redundancy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Front and rear RPM may intentionally differ by design; only the approved paired-rotor policy may define acceptable delta or ratio.

project_override_considerations: Define the five upper dual-rotor FRUs, `_R` mapping, front/rear relationship, fan-control/load context and RPM/status limits. Private/raw Script use must be pinned and reviewed if required; upper-front outcomes remain independent.
expected_evidence: Upper dual-rotor FRU and F/R tachometer map
Fan control/PWM/thermal/load context and approved rear/pair SPEC
Complete decoded IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Five protected upper-rear Web rows and page context
No-fan/SDR/power mutation or log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Script and criteria consistently identify upper rear-fan telemetry. Broad fan filtering, generic log clearing and DeepSeek's unsupported raw-only assumption are method defects, not a source-purpose conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Rear topology, pair mapping, access and SPEC are identifiable prerequisites. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if rear sensors cannot be distinguished and paired after those inputs are obtained.

review_improvement: Turns the R suffix into an explicit dual-rotor FRU relationship and prevents healthy front or unrelated fan telemetry from standing in for rear-rotor coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: A dual-rotor fan can lose one rotor while the other continues spinning, preserving airflow and a plausible generic fan list. Rear-tach health therefore requires its own identity and evidence, plus an approved relationship to the paired front rotor under the same control and sampling context.
